items.statement: Independent computation of the two public endpoint-defined events should identify site_C sulfur transfer as kinetically more accessible than site_O in the specified model boundary.
items.expected: The conclusion selects site_C only when candidate-level validation and a common-reference comparison support it.

items.statement: The defensible mechanistic interpretation is interaction- and geometry-based rather than a simple nucleophile/electrophile charge argument.
items.expected: The conclusion cites stronger sodium-pi/pi-pi organization for site_C and notes the charge trend does not account for the barrier ordering.

items.statement: The result is limited to initial sulfur transfer and does not establish the complete downstream cascade or exhaustive base aggregation.
items.expected: The report states this scope and its own search/model limitations.
